app.languageLimit: Single app-specific language; Android strips region with Locale.getLanguage, iOS uses first Bundle preferredLocalization. No setter or ranked native languages API in these four plugins. Validate returned tag/value at boundary.
app.lifecycle: appStateChange/pause/resume; Promise<PluginListenerHandle>, remove():Promise<void>. Own only your handles; do not call removeAllListeners.
app.scope: App iOS reads UIApplication state; 8.5 template is single scene, no multi-window support claim.

network.limits: Android checks INTERNET + VALIDATED network capabilities. iOS uses Reachability and resolves unavailable if monitor initialization fails; connected is not proof of authority endpoint success.

preferences.persistence: best-effort; set resolve and readback are not fsync/durable commit
preferences.implementation: Android SharedPreferences.Editor.apply(); iOS UserDefaults.standard with group prefix. Do not store credentials, entitlement proof or catalog.
preferences.malformedValues: Missing key rejects; invalid value differs across native implementations. Adapter must reject malformed/unallowlisted keys and values before plugin call.
preferences.privacy: Preferences README requires app PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy UserDefaults reason; CA92.1 is recommended for app-only settings, verify actual use. Core empty privacy manifest is insufficient.

browser.native: iOS SFSafariViewController accepts http and https; Android Uri.parse + CustomTabs has no application HTTPS/credential/control-character policy.
browser.policy: Apply shared strict HTTPS validation before SDK call; explicit user action only; no BrowserWeb fallback in public web graph, it uses window.open without noopener options.
browser.status: Native promise completion means browser presentation/request handling, not successful authenticated navigation. browserPageLoaded is initial-page-only; iOS emits it regardless of didLoadSuccessfully.

appLauncher.native: iOS UIApplication.shared.open completion; Android ACTION_VIEW/startActivity with completed:false if no handler succeeds.
appLauncher.mailto: Use only exact canonical mailto:probperasite@yandex.ru after explicit user action and host policy, with async false/rejection observed. Browser iOS cannot handle mailto. No arbitrary schemes, package IDs, recipients, cc/bcc or inferred message body.
appLauncher.probing: Optional canOpenUrl requires declared scheme queries: LSApplicationQueriesSchemes on iOS, Android11+ queries ACTION_VIEW/data scheme mailto. Direct openUrl does not need a preliminary canOpenUrl query.
appLauncher.meaning: completed indicates OS handoff, not message composition, account success or email delivery.

ios.note: Need later exact Package.resolved/CI dependency verification; npm exact pin alone does not lock SPM.

contractFindings.guard: SDK imports only in src/platform/adapters/android and ios; shared lifecycle/preference machinery receives structural injected functions and imports no Capacitor SDK. Native host receives bundled code; server.url/allowNavigation/live reload forbidden.
contractFindings.sdkBoundary: No Android CLI/SDK/JDK selection or installation made here; sdkmanager docs deprecated current interface. Apple environment task owns new CLI exact version, host constraints and license gate separately from Capacitor template requirements.

integrationProposal.sharedHostServices: Pure createHostPlatformServices(host) with structural capabilities, stable immutable snapshot, bounded async initialization, listener epochs, per-key serialized preference writes. Android/iOS adapters own real SDK imports and inject same plugin contracts.
integrationProposal.bootstrap: Resolve native app language and native non-secret preference before the one provider mount, with timeout/error result handled explicitly. Cache immutable preferred-language snapshot; do not await native reads inside getSnapshot or getSystemLanguages.
integrationProposal.listenerRace: Attach only on first subscriber. Remove exact handles; if async addListener resolves after last unsubscribe or epoch replacement, remove immediately. Ignore old getState/getStatus results after a newer event or lifetime ends.
integrationProposal.locale: Reuse existing InterfaceLanguageProvider and resolveInitialInterfaceLanguage; optional injected initial locale/preference port, same provider instance. Explicit route > saved RU/EN > validated native preference > existing controlled English fallback. Language changes update same context and serialize preference writes; no Canvas/renderer/provider remount or OS locale setter that recreates host.
integrationProposal.openLinkPort: Root-selected contract is OpenLinkResult | Promise<OpenLinkResult>. Native adapters await Browser.open or AppLauncher.openUrl; policy rejection -> blocked, native rejection or completed:false -> unavailable, successful native handoff -> requested. Never claim page success or mail delivery. Public Web may retain its existing synchronous behavior.
integrationProposal.nativeStrings: Add actual RU/EN resource localization and native usage strings after templates are generated; current templates do not supply bilingual parity. App.getAppLanguage is read-only; native-language switching capability remains explicit later work, not accepted by this package intake.
integrationProposal.nextValidation: After root-authorized dependency/build preparation: listener late-resolution/unsubscribe/StrictMode and initial-state-vs-event races; native preference rejection/readback/order; real same-Canvas RU/EN lifecycle on Android/iOS; exact compiled local resources and no remote runtime.
